tools.name: kinde_get_business
tools.description: Fetch the Kinde business this token belongs to — its name, industry and timezone. A cheap way to confirm the credentials and audience are right. Kinde: GET /api/v1/business.

tools.name: kinde_list_users
tools.description: List users in the business, optionally narrowed by email or user id. Kinde: GET /api/v1/users.

tools.name: kinde_get_user
tools.description: Fetch a single user by id, optionally expanded with their organizations and identities. Kinde: GET /api/v1/user.

tools.name: kinde_list_organizations
tools.description: List the organizations (tenants) in the business. Kinde: GET /api/v1/organizations.

tools.name: kinde_get_organization
tools.description: Fetch a single organization by its org code. Kinde: GET /api/v1/organization.

tools.name: kinde_list_organization_users
tools.description: List the users belonging to one organization, optionally filtered by the permissions or roles they hold. Kinde: GET /api/v1/organizations/{org_code}/users.

tools.name: kinde_get_user_roles_in_organization
tools.description: List the roles one user holds in one organization — the direct answer to 'what can this person do here?'. Kinde: GET /api/v1/organizations/{org_code}/users/{user_id}/roles.

tools.name: kinde_get_user_permissions_in_organization
tools.description: List the permissions one user holds in one organization. Kinde: GET /api/v1/organizations/{org_code}/users/{user_id}/permissions.

tools.name: kinde_list_roles
tools.description: List the roles defined in the business. Kinde: GET /api/v1/roles.

tools.name: kinde_list_role_permissions
tools.description: List the permissions attached to one role. Kinde: GET /api/v1/roles/{role_id}/permissions.

tools.name: kinde_list_permissions
tools.description: List the permissions defined in the business. Kinde: GET /api/v1/permissions.

tools.name: kinde_list_applications
tools.description: List the applications registered in the business, with their types. Kinde: GET /api/v1/applications.

tools.name: kinde_get_application
tools.description: Fetch a single application by id, including its client id and login URLs. Kinde: GET /api/v1/applications/{application_id}.

tools.name: kinde_list_apis
tools.description: List the APIs registered as token audiences. Kinde: GET /api/v1/apis.

tools.name: kinde_list_environment_feature_flags
tools.description: List the feature flags set at the environment level, with their values. Kinde: GET /api/v1/environment/feature_flags.

tools.name: kinde_list_organization_feature_flags
tools.description: List the feature-flag overrides set for one organization. Kinde: GET /api/v1/organizations/{org_code}/feature_flags.

tools.name: kinde_list_subscribers
tools.description: List marketing subscribers. Kinde: GET /api/v1/subscribers.

tools.name: kinde_create_organization
tools.description: Create a new organization (tenant) in the business. Kinde: POST /api/v1/organization.

tools.name: kinde_add_users_to_organization
tools.description: Add existing users to an organization, optionally with roles and permissions. Reversible by removing them. Kinde: POST /api/v1/organizations/{org_code}/users.

tools.name: kinde_grant_user_role_in_organization
tools.description: Give one user a role within one organization. Reversible with kinde_revoke_user_role_in_organization. Kinde: POST /api/v1/organizations/{org_code}/users/{user_id}/roles.

tools.name: kinde_grant_user_permission_in_organization
tools.description: Give one user a permission within one organization. Reversible. Kinde: POST /api/v1/organizations/{org_code}/users/{user_id}/permissions.

tools.name: kinde_create_role
tools.description: Create a role that can then be granted to users. Kinde: POST /api/v1/roles.

tools.name: kinde_create_permission
tools.description: Create a permission that roles and users can hold. Kinde: POST /api/v1/permissions.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "kinde_get_business" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Fetch the Kinde business this token belongs to — its name, industry and timezone. A cheap way to confirm the credentials and audience are right. Kinde: GET /api…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: kinde_list_users, kinde_get_application · Private data: kinde_get_business, kinde_list_apis · Public sink: kinde_list_users, kinde_create_organization, kinde_add_users_to_organization, kinde_grant_user_role_in_organization, kinde_grant_user_permission_in_organization, kinde_create_role, kinde_create_permission.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: kinde_list_users, kinde_get_application · Private data: kinde_get_business, kinde_list_apis · Public sink: kinde_list_users, kinde_create_organization, kinde_add_users_to_organization, kinde_grant_user_role_in_organization, kinde_grant_user_permission_in_organization, kinde_create_role, kinde_create_permission

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
